governing_cause: root_env_keys is a second gate narrower than Infisical prod /, and SessionStart names only four secrets, so a vault name is not treated as authorized until a human repeats it.
intervention: The live prod / listing is the authorization set. The committed allow-list mirrors it. Bind stays in-process. SessionStart publishes the name catalog. Machine-identity client secrets stay unissued. The operator-only refusal and its hosted IAM forbid are removed. MCP servers whose env name is a vault name spawn with that name bound into the child environment only.
